assist.description: Aim assist is on for this tick, a switch (ADR-072): a combo step faces the target.

auto.description:
Auto mode is on for this tick, a switch (ADR-073): the simulation plays the auto combo
at the target. Its presses come from the state, never from this record.

evade.description: The evade button (X) is held on this tick: a press dashes when an evade is ready.

main.description: The Main attack button (A) is held on this tick (ADR-070).

move_x.description:
Movement direction and strength, each −127 to 127 (−128 counts as −127). The simulation
clamps the vector to length 127 and scales it to the character's speed (ADR-071).

skill.description: The stage skill button (Y) is held on this tick (ADR-075; it does nothing yet).

sub.description: The Sub attack button (B) is held on this tick (ADR-070).
